note: Rock Island County Forest Preserve District's largest preserve, near Illinois City, on 167-acre Lake George (summer boat rentals) with a 12-mile trail loop. RV camping is in White Oak (back-in sites) and Deer Haven (concrete pull-throughs), both in the woods west of the lake, not on the water. Equestrians must camp in the separate Horse Corral campground. --Claude
